inspiration: MiroFish-style lightweight persona simulation: seed idea -> personas -> interaction rounds -> report signals.
idea: Herramienta para que restaurantes pequeños predigan demanda diaria y reduzcan desperdicio

selected_gap.title: Narrow painful workflow
selected_gap.pain: The idea needs one urgent job-to-be-done, not a broad feature set.
selected_gap.why_now: AI and modern software can compress expert work, but only if the workflow is specific.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Interview 5 target users and capture the exact task they already spend time or money on.
selected_gap.risk: If the workflow is vague, the product becomes a solution looking for a problem.

personas.lens: Daily workflow pain, speed, usability, trust.
personas.success_metric: The product saves time or reduces stress in a repeated task.
personas.default_objection: This sounds useful, but I already have a workaround.

personas.lens: Budget, ROI, risk, urgency, procurement friction.
personas.success_metric: The product clearly pays for itself this quarter or protects a critical metric.
personas.default_objection: Who owns the budget, and why would we buy now?

personas.lens: Implementation, process change, support load, reliability.
personas.success_metric: The workflow fits existing operations without creating extra coordination cost.
personas.default_objection: This may add another tool my team has to maintain.

personas.lens: How the status quo or large vendors defend the account.
personas.success_metric: The startup finds a wedge incumbents do not prioritize.
personas.default_objection: We can add this feature or bundle it with our existing platform.

personas.lens: Market size, founder insight, speed of learning, venture scale.
personas.success_metric: The idea has a sharp initial wedge and a path to a large market.
personas.default_objection: This may be a feature, not a company.

personas.lens: Data access, model quality, defensibility, COGS, failure modes.
personas.success_metric: The system can be built cheaply, reliably, and with a learning loop.
personas.default_objection: The demo may work, but edge cases and data access can break the product.

statements.claim: From the End user view, the idea is interesting only if it proves the product saves time or reduces stress in a repeated task.
statements.concern: This sounds useful, but I already have a workaround.
statements.evidence_request: Show a real recent example from the target customer segment.

statements.claim: From the Economic buyer view, the idea is interesting only if it proves the product clearly pays for itself this quarter or protects a critical metric.
statements.concern: Who owns the budget, and why would we buy now?
statements.evidence_request: Show a real recent example from the target customer segment.

statements.claim: From the Operations owner view, the idea is interesting only if it proves the workflow fits existing operations without creating extra coordination cost.
statements.concern: This may add another tool my team has to maintain.
statements.evidence_request: Show a real recent example from the target customer segment.

statements.claim: From the Incumbent competitor view, the idea is interesting only if it proves the startup finds a wedge incumbents do not prioritize.
statements.concern: We can add this feature or bundle it with our existing platform.
statements.evidence_request: Show a real recent example from the target customer segment.

statements.claim: From the YC partner view, the idea is interesting only if it proves the idea has a sharp initial wedge and a path to a large market.
statements.concern: This may be a feature, not a company.

statements.claim: From the Technical builder view, the idea is interesting only if it proves the system can be built cheaply, reliably, and with a learning loop.
statements.concern: The demo may work, but edge cases and data access can break the product.
statements.evidence_request: Show a real recent example from the target customer segment.

statements.claim: The selected gap must map to a task users already try to complete.
statements.concern: If users describe the problem abstractly, urgency is probably weak.
statements.evidence_request: Ask for the last 3 times this happened and what they did next.

statements.claim: Payment depends on a visible business metric, not enthusiasm.
statements.concern: A user can love the tool while the buyer refuses to pay.
statements.evidence_request: Identify the budget owner and a price anchor.

statements.claim: The wedge is acceptable if it compounds into a much larger workflow.
statements.concern: The current scope may be a narrow feature.
statements.evidence_request: Describe the expansion path after the first repeated use case.

statements.claim: The next test should simulate delivery before building infrastructure.
statements.concern: Engineering too early hides weak demand signals.
statements.evidence_request: Run a concierge version with 3 users.

statements.claim: The startup needs a wedge incumbents ignore because it looks too small or too custom.
statements.concern: A generic AI layer is easy to copy.
statements.evidence_request: List what proprietary workflow data accumulates after 30 days.

statements.claim: The technical plan should optimize for low COGS and controlled output variance.
statements.concern: LLM quality variance can destroy trust in repeated workflows.
statements.evidence_request: Define fallback behavior, logging, and pass/fail checks.

consensus.strongest_signal: Proceed only if target users describe a recent, repeated, expensive problem in their own words.
consensus.weakest_assumption: The fallback simulation does not know the real market; live research or interviews must replace generic assumptions.
consensus.adoption_path: Start with a narrow concierge workflow, then productize the repeated steps.
consensus.pricing_test: Ask for a small paid pilot tied to the buyer's success metric.

recommended_interventions: Narrow the customer segment until the end user and buyer are obvious.
Run interviews around recent behavior, not opinions about the idea.
Prototype the outcome manually before building a scalable product.
Track what data or workflow insight compounds with each use.
